title: The Conversations That Changed Everything
intro: And then came the moment I still remember so clearly…
hmmMessage: Before I say anything, I'll just say “hmm” first… so you'll know it's me. 😂
hmmNote: It was such a small thing, but somehow it became our little thing.
callOpening: And then we called. We started talking… and somehow, we just didn't stop.
One topic became another. One story became another. One laugh became another.

timeProgression.afterText: Our very first call… and we talked for five hours straight.

naturalness: It felt so natural, like we'd already known each other for much longer. There were no awkward silences. No feeling of “What should I say next?”
We just kept talking, laughing, sharing little things, getting to know each other, and slowly getting closer.

studyMoment: And the sweetest part? I had my history paper the next day, and she had her geometry paper. 😂
I probably should have been studying… but there I was, lost in a five-hour conversation with her. And honestly? I didn't regret a single minute.
meaning: Because that call wasn't just a phone call to me. It was the first time I truly got to hear her, know her, and feel that there was something different between us.
fiveMinutesLine: When we finally ended the call, it almost felt strange that the conversation had to stop. Five hours felt like five minutes.
realization: Maybe I had found someone I could talk to for hours and still want five more minutes.
closing: That first call will always have a special place in my heart.
Somewhere between that first “hmm” and those five unforgettable hours…
she started becoming more than just a girl I had met.
